## Purpose

Describe the problem and intended behavior within the authorized scope.

## Changes

List the relevant files or functions and why they need to change.

## Verification

Report checks actually performed, their results, data provenance and unverified scope. Synthetic tests do not establish device behavior or scientific validity.

## Research and operational impact

- [ ] Preserve working code and keep changes focused.
- [ ] Exclude credentials, private identifiers and unapproved research material.
- [ ] State any control, firmware or data-schema changes.
- [ ] Distinguish independent review from deployment approval.
- [ ] Identify what a reviewer should check after merging.

Merging a change does not by itself authorize cloud deployment or device operation.
